roles.catalog_nomination: Published candidate list or explicit target nomination. Membership supplies provenance, not automatic CTA admission.
roles.cancer_embryo_program: Defined embryo or DUX4 program used in cancer experiments. This is program membership, not proof that every member is tumor restricted.
roles.reproductive_developmental: Human reproductive or developmental biology; species, tissue and stage remain attached to each finding.
roles.normal_tissue: Normal-cell or tissue findings used to review expression conflicts. Family, isoform and reagent limits remain explicit.
roles.tumor_expression: Tumor RNA or protein observations. RNA, endogenous protein, constructs and fusions are distinguished.
roles.immune_recognition: Antibody, vaccine, CAR or T-cell experiments, with the tested product and model retained.
roles.translation_identity: Gene, transcript, proteoform or translation evidence, including evidence against a proposed coding assignment.
roles.function: Mechanistic or biochemical experiments; model-system results do not establish normal human expression.
roles.association: DNA variants, copy number, methylation or statistical associations. These do not establish protein production.
roles.background_screen: Broad measured/scored-gene table. A row is not a nomination or a gene-specific experiment.
roles.upstream_program: Original source of a reused gene set; reused memberships do not count as independent replication.
roles.measurement: Reference sequence and expression datasets used by the classification gates.

coverage_rule: Exact human locus or gene-specific study, including explicitly labelled genomic associations. Broad screen rows, unresolved family/copy assays, animal-only studies and unverified leads do not supply exact-human paper coverage. Coverage is a reading/provenance measure, not a CTA admission gate.
core_rule: Cover all eligible paper-to-protein memberships, with required unique contributions first, then largest uncovered contribution and deterministic tie breaking, followed by removal of redundant papers. The result is an inclusion-minimal cover, not a claimed minimum-cardinality solution. Supplementary papers retain evidence beyond name coverage.
